newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TMM lowered by Caspian.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TMM lowered by Caspian.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities downgraded Mexico's largest shipping firm, Transportacin Martima Mexicana (TMM), Tuesday to sell from market performer.

-- Senior oil and shipping analyst Phokion Potamianos said Tuesday the brokerage lowered the stock to market performer a month ago after the company in a joint venture successfully bid for a key Mexican railroad for $1.4 billion.
-- "We've done a working model of the railroad and based on the dilution from acquisition, we expect a working loss for 1997 and 1998," Potamianos told Reuters.
-- He said the railroad company formed by TMM and Kansas City Southern Industries Inc could be profitable by 2001, but until then he expects the stock to underperform the local market.
-- The venture's bid was almost three times competing bids and spurred analyst concerns over the companies' debt. Neither company has provided financing details for the railway.
-- TMM American Depositary Receipts were down 1/8 at 5-1/4 at midday.
